narrative:
Inventory optimization analysis for material PL3__M1F8BAA4 reveals an ERRATIC demand pattern with mean daily demand of 502 units (CV=0.63). 
The material exhibits normal distribution with 93.9% non-zero demand days. 
Lead time is VOLATILE (CV=0.80) with mean of 1.13 days, requiring a safety stock of 926 units for 95% service level.

The dominant source of uncertainty is supplier variability (64% of total variance).

Economic order quantity is 3978 units, but capacity constraints limit the order quantity to 3935 units (storage utilization: 100%).

Recommended policy: Safety Stock = 926 units, Reorder Point = 1491 units, Order Quantity = 3935 units, Review Period = 8 days.

This optimized policy yields annual savings of $20,732 (78%) compared to the current SAP policy, primarily by reducing ordering frequency from 351 to 32 orders per year.
